Maximum Subarray Sum.java:
import java.util.*;
public class Main{public static void main(String[] z){Scanner s=new Scanner(System.in);int n=s.nextInt();long best,cur,x=s.nextLong();best=cur=x;for(int i=1;i<n;i++){x=s.nextLong();cur=Math.max(x,cur+x);best=Math.max(best,cur);}System.out.println(best);}}

Container with most Water.java:
import java.util.*;
public class Main{public static void main(String[] z){Scanner s=new Scanner(System.in);int n=s.nextInt();long[] h=new long[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)h[i]=s.nextLong();int l=0,r=n-1;long best=0;while(l<r){best=Math.max(best,(long)(r-l)*Math.min(h[l],h[r]));if(h[l]<h[r])l++;else r--;}System.out.println(best);}}
